answer: Checkable work: instead of open essays, each round gives every identity a different task whose answer can be checked mechanically, such as finding a bug in a short code kernel or solving a constraint puzzle seeded from the round's beacon. Pay goes only to correct, independent solutions, so honest agents grow along a trellis of verified results. A sybil operator can't copy one solution across seats, because each seat's task differs, so a river of fakes needs a river of real solving work, and the cost of every fake equals the reward it chases.
